 PRODUCTS 
 DROP & SHOCK 
SHINYEI Group manufactures and supplies Drop & Shock Testing System, Field Data Logger, Acceleration Measuring System, Instruments for Railway.
 Drop Test Systems 
 Shock Test Systems 
 Material Testing System 
 Acceleration Measurement 
 Field Data Recorder 
Drop Test Systems
SHINYEI drop testers provide you accurate and reproducible drop tests for wide range of test specimen such as smart phones, wearable devices, batteris, packaged products, and various mobile products.
 READ MORE 
Shock Test Systems
SHINYEI shock test and measurement systems for every shock pulse - Half Sine, Square/Trapezoidal Pulse with your preferred acceleration and pulse duration, archieving minimum noise, compact design, and easy operation.
 READ MORE 
Material Testing System
Our material testing system can conduct the dynamic compression test to identify the characteristics of cushioning materials. Shock response acceleration and displacement waveform of cushioning material are captured with ease when the compressive plate is dropped using this tester.
 READ MORE 
Acceleration Measurement
Our accelerometer surely helps in the analysis of shock and vibration acceleration to drive rationalization and cost reduction forward in the line of physical distribu-tion, manufacturing and development. Shock & Vibration Data Logger AccStick extremely small device with built-in 3D accelerometer, flash- memory and rechargeable battery has been released. 3D acceleration waveforms are captured via high speed sam-pling, at 1600Hz max.
 READ MORE 
Field Data Recorder
SHINYEI TECHNOLOGY we handle various transport environment recorders, Field Data Recorder and shock data recorders such as DER-1000 Field Data Logger for Transportation Environment which measures 3 axis acceleration and temperature and humidity generated during transportation, Compact Shock Recorder FIR-106 which measures and records the vibration and shock that measures vibration and impact during product transportation and G-MEN ultra compact Acceleration & Impact data recorder capable of measuring large quantities of various distribution routes as a compact recorder for monitoring logistics hazards.
 READ MORE
